title: The Dollar is Soaring (Rate Hikes Incoming)
speaker: Nick and Alan (A1 Trading), with Chris

macro_themes.view: Headline 3.7% vs 3.6% and core 2.6% vs 2.5% exp.; sticky inflation puts Fed on rate-hike watch.
October hike odds jumped toward 50/50; the Fed should act on data despite the election and is behind the curve.
S&P relies on ~30 stocks; 2027 earnings growth expected to roughly halve, damping momentum.
Close to a money-printing regime where gold ultimately wins even if everything falls first.

calls.condition: if CPI cooler than expected, buy break and retest of 4,200-4,240
calls.reason: Edge Finder score borderline +3; a cool CPI would get them bullish on a break and retest of 4,200/4,240. CPI came in hot (no follow-up gold call). Longer term, a shift to money printing ('paradigm D') makes gold one of the better winners.
calls.quote: a cool print probably gets me off the fence and bullish on precious metals

calls.condition: if CPI hot and BTC breaks back below ~80,000, sell the reversal
calls.reason: Higher inflation and rates pressure crypto; on a hot print would short a break back below ~80,000 / reversal of the uptrend. Print came in hot.
calls.quote: Bitcoin I'd be looking for a break back beneath like 80,000 ... Then I'd be looking to maybe sell into a potential reversal

calls.condition: if 2,400 breaks to the downside on a hot print, look for short continuation
calls.reason: Same hot-CPI crypto short thesis; clean level at 2,400.

calls.reason: Hot CPI and rate-hike cycle that began in September typically means 3-5 months of rocky stocks; hopes for a pullback before year end, earnings growth slowing in 2027.
calls.quote: we could have a rocky rocky road here until the end of the year

notes: Live CPI-release stream; no explicit date said, listing approx_date used (CPI day). Gold and crypto setups were conditional on the print; print was hot. Silver mentioned alongside gold only in passing.
